name: mira
description: Quiet · compact · precise: neutral greys, 28px controls with 12px text, flat unshadowed surfaces and hairline rings instead of drop shadows.

forkedFrom.note: Created by tooling/new-system from foundation on 2026-09-16, right after foundation was corrected against the mira reference app; the two are the same values.

source.note: shadcn create preset base-mira (npx shadcn@4.21.0 init -t next -b base -p mira); values checked against the reference app with tooling/snapshot/compare-shadcn.mjs. foundation carries the same values, so this system is the user-facing copy of it.
